manual_compatibility_workflow.scope: All fork Go tests with race detection, full vet, same-fork CLI build and classic Shadowsocks client/server TCP/UDP self-wire

verified_custom_additions: Shadowsocks AES-192-GCM: explicit client/server/multi-user configuration, TCP and UDP
Shadowsocks AES-128/192/256-CFB, CTR and OFB: explicit single-user client/server, TCP and UDP
Shadowsocks AEAD server-first: ignore an empty initial inbound buffer instead of encoding an end marker
Shadowsocks bf-cfb, cast5-cfb, des-cfb, rc4, rc4-md5, salsa20, chacha20, chacha20-ietf, table, none/plain: explicit single-user TCP/UDP
Original ChaCha20 64-bit counter carry, Salsa20 counter exhaustion, per-account immutable table permutations
Shadowsocks camellia-128/192/256-cfb, idea-cfb, rc2-cfb (128 effective bits), seed-cfb (SEED-128): explicit single-user TCP/UDP
SOCKS4 and SOCKS4a outbound TCP CONNECT: explicit versions, user ID, local IPv4 versus remote domain resolution; SOCKS5 default unchanged
ss2022_selftest_scope: SS2022 package tests exist; classic self-wire fixture does not include SS2022
